text: Design a priority software queue feeding an NVMe submission queue: P0 exact misses preempt P3 speculative fetches. Submitted requests cannot be cancelled. Include R1 hold-speculative-in-software-queue, R2 cap speculative bytes in flight to one tile, R3 speculate-only-when-no-exact-pending. Write tests for the bound: always-wrong predictor must add at most cap/B + t_req delay to any exact miss.
